simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַגָּל (H4038) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מַגָּל (maggâl) means a sickle First listed occurrence: Jer 50 16.

definitions.full: H4038. maggal מוֺלֶ֫דֶת noun feminine kindred, birth, offspring ; — ׳מ construct Lev 18:9 , 11 ; suffix מוֺלַדְתִּי Gen 24:4 3 t.; etc.; plural suffix מוֺלְדוֺתַיִךְ Ezek 16:4 ; מֹלְדֹתַיִךְ 16:3 ; — 1 kindred Gen 12:1 (|| אביך בית ארצך, ), 24:4 (|| ארץ ), Num 10:30 (|| id. ), Gen 31:3 (|| אבותיך ארץ ), 43:7 (all J); || עַם Est 2:10 , 20 ; 8:6 ; especially מ ׳אֶרֶץ land of one's kindred Gen 11:28 ; 24:7 (both J), 31:13 (E), Jer 22:10 ; 46:16 ; Ezek 23:15 ; Ruth 2:11 . 2 plural circumstances of birth, birth (figurative of origin of Jerusalem) וּמ ׳מְכֹרֹתַיִךְ הַכְּנַעֲנִי מֵאֶרֶץ Ezek 16:3 , compare 16:4 . 3 (female) offspring, one born Lev 18:9 (twice in verse), begotten 18:11 (all H); collective = issue, offspring הוֺלַ֫דְתָּ אֲשֶׁר מוֺלַדְתְּךָ Gen 48:6 (P). מַגָּל noun [masculine] sickle (Arabic (yet possibly Aramaic loan-word Frä 133 ), Aramaic ); — with תָּפַשׂ handle, wield Jer 50:16 (|| זָרַע ); with שָׁלַח Joel 4:13 figurative of judgement.
